en: Hrrm!? I found some dinosaur bones!{PAGE}Such terrible table manners. It was{SAUT}clearly eating with its hands.
You're the last one who should be{SAUT}judging someone's table manners...
Can you check the bones, Crow?
Yes, I'm looking at them right now.{PAGE}These bones are starting to wear down.{SAUT}They must be very old.
That won't do.{OPTION}Let's try somewhere else.
Haha, Koromaru-kun seems to agree.{PAGE}We're looking for fresh sets of bones.{SAUT}Let's keep our eyes open.
